title: Momcozy V1 Pro Wearable Breast Pump, Hospital-Grade Pocket Primary Pump
bullets: Built for Real Milk Removal: With hospital grade breast pump suction up to 300mmHg, 3 fine-tuned rhythms, and 15 adjustable levels, the Momcozy V1pro supports stronger, more personalized pumping—not just wearable breast pump convenience.

Carry It Like a Daily BabyEssential : Slip the motor into a bag or pocket and pump through work, commutes, chores, or baby essentials. A 2300mAh battery supports up to 8–9 sessions per charge for more freedom through the day.

Lighter Wear, Visible Output: Each collector weighs only 120g for a lighter feel on the breast. Unlike bottle-style pumps, this hands free breast pump is made for direct use. Transparent cups with clear markings let you check output at a glance.

Quiet, Comfortable, Leak-Resistant: Quiet 48dB operation, a 102° angled tunnel, and soft silicone DoubleFit flange support a more comfortable fit, while a leak-resistant design helps keep daily pumping more secure.

Better Fit, Easy to Clean: With multiple insert sizes, measuring guidance, and only 3 milk-contact parts, Momcozy breast pump helps moms get a better fit, easier cleaning, and a smoother start from day one.
